2607.22139.title: CARDIAG: A Dense Segment Classification Benchmark of Deep Learning Architectures for Coronary Angiography
2607.22139.paper_summary: Accurate pixel-level classification of coronary angiograms is critical for cardiovascular disease assessment, yet the field lacks standardized evaluation protocols. In this work we demonstrate a new benchmark for the assessment of deep learning models which densely classify pixels of coronary angiograms to one of SYNTAX classes (or background). The evaluation covers 24 distinct architectures starting with classic convnets to recent state-space-based vision algorithms. We release CARDIAG - a multi-center, multi-label dataset which we carefully split to reliably compute metrics, accounting for diameter error, overlap, centerline quality and calibration. The data contains SYNTAX labels, binary, uncertainty and segmentation masks as well as intermediate frames together with the selected non-sensitive DICOM metadata. From the multitude of algorithms, we nominate ConvNeXt V2 encoder with DeepLab V3 Plus decoder as the best performing, achieving macro $F_1=0.456$, which we then ensemble with Mamba U-Net and Feature Pyramid Network, for an increased $F_1=0.479$. We demonstrate all the architectures to be well calibrated and determine the generalization of the top 5 methods, together with the data efficiency of these architectures. We highlight the importance of both high-resolution and low-resolution features in encoding. We also demonstrate the model correctness in the context of patient demographic, vessel sides and projection angle configurations. Overall the released benchmark allows for future studies to robustly and rigorously assess the proposals, not only for SYNTAX segmentation, but lesion detection and many more.
2607.22139.paper_summary_zh: 精確的冠狀動脈造影像素級分類對於心血管疾病評估至關重要，但該領域缺乏標準化的評估協議。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們展示了一個新的基準，用於評估深度學習模型，這些模型將冠狀動脈造影的像素密集地分類為SYNTAX類別（或背景）。<lb/>評估涵蓋了24種不同的架構，從經典的卷積網絡到最近的基於狀態空間的視覺算法。<lb/>我們發布了CARDIAG - 一個多中心、多標籤的數據集，我們仔細劃分以可靠地計算指標，考慮到直徑誤差、重疊、中心線質量和校準。<lb/>數據包含SYNTAX標籤、二進制、不確定性和分割掩碼，以及中間幀和選定的非敏感DICOM元數據。<lb/>在眾多算法中，我們提名ConvNeXt V2編碼器與DeepLab V3 Plus解碼器為最佳表現，達到宏觀$F_1=0.456$，然後與Mamba U-Net和特徵金字塔網絡進行集成，提升至$F_1=0.479$。<lb/>我們展示了所有架構均經過良好校準，並確定了前五種方法的泛化能力，以及這些架構的數據效率。<lb/>我們強調高解析度和低解析度特徵在編碼中的重要性。<lb/>我們還展示了模型在患者人口統計、血管側面和投影角度配置方面的正確性。<lb/>總體而言，發布的基準允許未來的研究能夠穩健而嚴謹地評估提案，不僅限於SYNTAX分割，還包括病變檢測等更多方面。
